name: Album Covers by Abracadabrax
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Give ChatGPT the title of your album, single, EP, mixtape or playlist, the artist name, the genre and the mood, and get square cover art that still reads as a small thumbnail on streaming platforms, with the title and the artist set into the artwork or no text at all.

The plugin prepares a square draft with the visual style, the lettering and the image model, and shows the credits it will use. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders the cover and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For independent artists, producers and playlist curators.

Limitations: covers from text only. It does not put your own photo or band logo on the cover, edit an existing cover or make the music. Producing uses credits of the user's Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.

limitations_ja: テキストからの作成のみ。自分の写真・ロゴの配置や既存表紙の編集、音楽の制作は非対応。生成にクレジットを使用。
